verdict.rationale: Hoppscotch has its own programmatic surfaces. Its official MCP server lets an agent read and change collections, requests, environments, and teams, and can send real HTTP requests. The CLI runs tests and manages collections from a terminal or automated system. Parity with the UI is not shown: no public REST/GraphQL API is documented, the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path, and there is no evidence that admin settings, SSO configuration, or user management can be done outside the UI. missing for 10: a documented public API with an OpenAPI spec, explicit UI/API parity coverage (admin dashboard, user management, workspace settings), and independent corroboration.
